description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Exploration of the Utility and Accuracy of Apple iPad LiDAR Technology is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joseph Wartman, University of Washington (washington.edu). The objective of this research paper is to evaluate the feasibility of using scans collected from various iPad LiDAR applications to connect and register Terrestrial LiDAR Scanner (TLS) scans to one another in indoor and outdoor environments. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-knxp-p380. Keywords: NHERI RAPID Reconnaissance Facility, Terrestrial LiDAR Scanning, TLS, Mobile LiDAR, LiDAR, Leica RTC360. Published 2022-09-23. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
